quotes.text: Do you want to ask [name] the earnings questions now?
What was your gross pay, that is your pay before any deductions, the last time you were paid?
In the week ending Sunday the [date], were you claiming any State Benefits or Tax Credits (including State Pension, Allowances, Child Benefit or National Insurance Credits)?
How many hours per week do you usually work in your (main) job/business – please exclude meal breaks?
Thinking now about the seven days ending Sunday the …, how many hours did you actually work in your (main) job/business – please exclude meal breaks?
In which of these ways do you occupy this accommodation? Make sure answer applies to HRP
Record if [Name] is person in whose name this accommodation is owned or rented

assessments.reasoning:
1. economic_maintenance: False. The instrument collects gross/net earnings only for employees (GROSS99, p. 216) and benefit receipt for individual named recipients (BENFTS, p. 129). It does not collect income across all sources (such as self-employment income, informal work earnings, or remittances) at the individual member level.
2. labor_burden: False. The instrument collects usual and actual hours spent in paid employment, self-employment, and family business work (TOTUS1, p. 82; TOTAC1, p. 83), but does not record hours spent in unpaid domestic or care work.
3. property_asset_control: False. Accommodation tenure is recorded at the household level specifically in relation to the Household Reference Person (TEN1, p. 13: 'Make sure answer applies to HRP'; HRPID, p. 12), rather than collecting individual property or asset ownership for all members.
4. decision_making: False. The instrument contains no questions evaluating decision-making agency across household spheres (such as child-rearing, daily consumption, or major financial choices).
